extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and research administrators preparing applications to AHRC/UKRI funding opportunities (UK research organisations)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for preparing and submitting applications to AHRC/UKRI funding opportunities, including eligibility, funding amounts, application modes (invite-only), and key deadlines. Covers specific opportunity metadata applicants must follow.

rubrics_metrics.name: AHRC funding scope
rubrics_metrics.description: AHRC funds outstanding original research across the whole range of the arts and humanities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use AHRC funding where the project is within the arts and humanities remit and demonstrates originality and high quality; consult AHRC pages for remit, strategy, and programmes for detailed fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation-only application requirement (UKRI metascience scientometrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This opportunity is not open to unsolicited applications; only invited applicants may submit. Check invitation communications and the opportunity page for timelines: Publication date: 28 April 2026; Opening date: 28 April 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing date: 2 June 2026 4:00pm UK time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding level and full economic cost (UKRI metascience scientometrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect to fund up to £3 million at 80% full economic cost (FEC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total fund indicated: £3,000,000. Applicants should prepare budgets consistent with 80% FEC funding level and follow UKRI/AHRC costing rules and institutional arrangements for FEC applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funders and co-funders (UKRI metascience scientometrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: This opportunity is funded by UK Research and Innovation and the research councils: ESRC, NERC, BBSRC, AHRC, STFC, EPSRC, MRC; co-funder: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collaborative or cross-council expectations may apply; check eligibility and any additional requirements from co-funders and lead funder guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity metadata and status (UKRI metascience scientometrics)
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunity status: Open; Funding type: Grant; Publication date, opening date and closing date are provided with precise UK times.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere strictly to published opening/closing dates and times (UK time). Confirm submission method and any portal constraints when the opportunity opens.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility: must be based at UK research organisation (Video games and gambling-related harms)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for UKRI funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants must be employed by or formally hosted by an eligible UK research organisation; check UKRI eligibility guidance for eligible organisation types and any institutional verification required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding type, total fund and maximum award (Video games and gambling-related harms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Funding type: Grant. Total fund: £5,000,000. Maximum award: £1,000,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare budget requests within the maximum award limit and in line with funder costing rules. The total programme fund and maximum per-award cap will influence project scale and consortium design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funders (Video games and gambling-related harms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Funders listed: Medical Research Council (MRC), Arts and Humanities Research Council (AHRC), Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC), Economic and Social Research Council (ESRC), and UK Research and Innovation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-council funding implies interdisciplinary expectations; review each funder's remit and any joint-funders' requirements for reporting, impact, or eligible costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunity metadata and status (Video games and gambling-related harms)
rubrics_metrics.description: Opportunity status: Open; Publication date: 24 April 2026; Opening date: 8 May 2026 9:00am UK time; Closing date: 23 July 2026 4:00pm UK time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note precise opening and closing times in UK time and plan institutional approval, proposal preparation, and submission to meet deadlines. Confirm submission portal details when the call opens.
